Elena — thanks for the draft and the chat earlier. Attaching our intake plan for tracking the redlines. I copied Karthik (account lead) and Marissa (legal) to own review and propose counterpoints.

Quick answers:
- We can accept DocuSign for signature routing; procurement sends envelope, we sign via our legal team.

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DPA draft for Redwood — next steps

Thanks — I reviewed ClearWave's redline. High-level notes:

1) Data residency (PHI): We can commit to US-only processing for their account under Redwood Dedicated, but that requires a short addendum and a 30-day lead time for provisioning.

2) Audit logs / SOC2 evidence: we'll provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and an operations evidence package. See attached security sheet.

3) Indemnity and liability caps: ClearWave's draft increases exposure beyond our standard; propose we revert to our standard liability cap (contract value x1) and accept carveouts limited to gross negligence and willful misconduct.

4) DPIA and data subject rights language: Laura, can you confirm the proposed wording on controller/processor obligations?

Karthik — if the US-only Dedicated requirement is acceptable, we need to surface the cost delta (approx +20% monthly) so ClearWave understands the commercial impact.

I'll prepare a tracked counter-redline (target EOD) to send back to Elena.

—Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Elena — attaching our counter-redline and a short note on signature flow. Summary:

- We accepted most standard privacy provisions and clarified processor obligations.
- Data residency: we can do US-only processing under a Dedicated deployment; added an addendum and explicit lead time (30 days).
- Liability: proposed reverting to Redwood's standard cap; offered to discuss exceptions case-by-case.

Signature routing: preferred path is ClearWave sends DocuSign envelope to procurement@clearwave.health -> Jonas (AE) signs the commercial SOW (if included) -> Marissa (legal) signs the DPA via DocuSign. Alternatively, we can sign first and return to your procurement team.

Karthik — please confirm the Dedicated pricing delta so we can include it with the counter.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
